facts.fact: 维克多回到洛克兰大学，身体还记得科学楼之间那条路
facts.anchor: It had been a lifetime, but his body remembered the route between the science buildings

facts.fact: 他眼前会浮出金发女孩、黑毛狗、狱友和死去的好友，幻觉几乎不间断
facts.anchor: a blond-haired girl, or a black-furred dog, a cellmate, or a dead best friend

facts.fact: 丹妮推算他已经服用这种化合物两年半
facts.anchor: And you’ve been taking it for, what, two and a half years?

facts.fact: 丹妮伸手去拿电话时，维克多把手一握，她的身体被定住
facts.anchor: Victor flexed his hand, and hers froze.

facts.fact: 他请她做的是吸入后切断他与自身能力的血清
facts.anchor: It’s a serum that, when inhaled, severs me from my abilities.

facts.fact: 维克多把实情全说出去，是一次计算过的冒险
facts.anchor: It was a calculated risk, so much transparency.

facts.fact: 丹妮让他第二天晚上八点再来，并说会去预约实验室
facts.anchor: Come back tomorrow night at eight.

facts.fact: 丹妮警告他：未经她明确允许再用能力，她就让他死
facts.anchor: If you ever use your powers on me again without express permission, I’ll let you die.
